description: This file declares the Stop class, which is a task for stopping a WebAudio player within the Rialto server component. It includes class declaration, constructor, destructor, and execute method, and references external interfaces for WebAudio player and task management.

classes.name: Stop
classes.description: A task class responsible for stopping the WebAudio player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Stop task with a reference to the WebAudio player.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the stop operation on the WebAudio player.
